templates.text: The lungs show delayed surfactant production, leading to a weak, gasping cry.
Cardiac septation is incomplete, resulting in a persistent murmur and poor perfusion.
Renal development is stunted, with fewer nephrons and a risk of electrolyte imbalance.
The auditory system is underdeveloped, causing a muted response to sound stimuli.
Hepatic enzyme systems are immature, struggling to process bilirubin effectively.
Cerebral gyration is simplified, suggesting potential for later neural network delays.
Intestinal villi are sparse and short, compromising nutrient absorption from the start.
The diaphragm is thin and weak, contributing to shallow, irregular respiratory effort.
Pancreatic islet cell clusters are poorly formed, hinting at future metabolic challenges.
Thymic development is limited, foreshadowing a vulnerable adaptive immune response.
Bone ossification centers are delayed, leaving the skeletal frame notably fragile.
The visual system lags; retinal vasculature is sparse and pupillary reflexes are sluggish.
Adrenal cortex is underdeveloped, with a blunted stress hormone response.
Myelination of major nerve tracts is sparse, slowing neural transmission.
The cry is weak and breathy, sustained for only {seconds} seconds before fading.
Vascular integrity is compromised, leading to easy bruising and poor thermoregulation.
Gastrointestinal motility is disorganized, with prolonged periods of silent abdomen.
The laryngeal structure is delicate, producing a high-pitched, thin cry.
Pulmonary vasculature remains constricted, predisposing to persistent fetal circulation.
Hematopoietic function is sluggish, with prolonged low counts across cell lines.
The sucking reflex is weak and uncoordinated, tiring after a few attempts.
Renal tubules are underdeveloped, impairing the concentration of urine.
Cartilaginous structures in the airway are overly pliant, risking collapse during inspiration.
The startle reflex is present but dampened, with a slow, incomplete motor response.
Biliary tree development is rudimentary, affecting bile flow and digestion of fats.
The skin barrier is thin and permeable, prone to excessive transepidermal water loss.
Cochlear development is incomplete, filtering sound into a muffled, indistinct range.
Myocardial muscle fibers are poorly organized, resulting in diminished contractile force.
The rooting reflex requires persistent stimulation over {seconds} seconds to elicit.
Alveolar sacs are fewer and thicker-walled, significantly reducing gas exchange surface area.
